N: Number 23.
W: When is the sales report due?

N: (B) At ten o'clock.
N: (C) The director has a conflict.

N: (A) About fifty dollars.
N: (B) The black one on the shelf.
N: (C) It was a good presentation.

N: Number 29.
W: How did the negotiation go?
N: (A) Around the table.
N: (B) Mr. Kim was there.
N: (C) Better than we expected.

N: (A) It's a fast train.
N: (B) From platform four.
N: (C) At a quarter past nine.

W: How much does the express delivery cost?
N: (A) Within two days.
N: (B) Twelve dollars extra.
N: (C) The courier is outside.

M: Who should I send the expense form to?
N: (A) About two hundred dollars.
N: (B) Submit it to the accounting office.
N: (C) It was approved yesterday.

W: What's the best way to reach the technical support team?
N: (A) They are very helpful.
N: (B) Through the help line on the website.
N: (C) Last Tuesday.

N: (A) In the interview room.
N: (B) She has more experience with our software.
N: (C) Yes, the first one too.

W: How long is the warranty on this printer?
N: (A) It prints very quickly.
N: (B) Two years from the purchase date.
N: (C) About three meters.

N: Number 36.
M: Where will the new employees be sitting?
N: (A) Near the window on the fourth floor.
N: (B) Five of them.
N: (C) Starting next Monday.

N: (A) Fifty boxes.
N: (B) On the loading dock.
N: (C) Sometime next week, I think.

M: Who has the key to the supply cabinet?
N: (A) In the top drawer.
N: (B) Only two of them.
N: (C) Daniel at reception does.

W: Is the conference room available this afternoon?
N: (A) No, the sales team has it until four.
N: (B) It's on the third floor.
N: (C) She asked me to confirm.

M: Did you finish the quarterly budget?
N: (A) Almost, I'll send it tonight.
N: (B) Yes, it costs a lot.
N: (C) Two quarters ago.

N: (A) Thanks, that would be great.
N: (B) I did last week.
N: (C) They're in the warehouse.

M: Has the new hire started yet?
N: (A) The hire price is low.
N: (B) In human resources.
N: (C) She begins on Monday.

N: Number 43.
W: Are you taking the early flight or the afternoon one?
N: (A) A window seat, please.
N: (B) The afternoon one is cheaper.
N: (C) Yes, it was early.

N: Number 44.
M: Isn't the warehouse open on Saturdays?
N: (A) It's near the harbor.
N: (B) Only until noon.
N: (C) No, he didn't.

N: Number 45.
W: Will the client sign the agreement today?
N: (A) At the front desk.
N: (B) He's reading it now.
N: (C) The agreement was long.

N: Number 46.
M: Can I use this printer for color copies?
N: (A) It was printed yesterday.
N: (B) The copies are on my desk.
N: (C) Yes, but you need a code.

N: Number 47.
W: Does the hotel have a shuttle service?
N: (A) The hotel was nice.
N: (B) Two nights.
N: (C) Yes, every thirty minutes.

N: Number 48.
M: Were you at the training session last Friday?
N: (A) No, I was out of town.
N: (B) The training was free.
N: (C) It starts at nine.

N: Number 49.
W: Would you mind closing the window?
N: (A) It's a nice view.
N: (B) Not at all.
N: (C) Yes, I'd love to.

N: Number 50.
M: Let's have lunch together tomorrow.
N: (A) Sure, what time works for you?
N: (B) In the cafeteria upstairs.
N: (C) It was delicious.

N: Number 51.
W: Could you please forward me the agenda?
N: (A) It's on the agenda.
N: (B) I'll send it right away.
N: (C) Forward to the next speaker.

N: Number 52.
M: I'd like to reserve a table for six on Friday.
N: (A) What time would you like to come?
N: (B) Yes, I do.
N: (C) The tables are made of oak.

N: Number 53.
W: Why don't we hire a part-time assistant?
N: (A) Part of the budget.
N: (B) That sounds like a good idea.
N: (C) Because he's busy.

N: Number 54.
M: Please remember to lock the office when you leave.
N: (A) At about six.
N: (B) The lock is broken.
N: (C) I will, thanks for the reminder.

N: Number 55.
W: I can't find my access card.
N: (A) It's a blue card.
N: (B) Yes, access is open.
N: (C) Try the lost-and-found box at reception.

N: Number 56.
M: Would you like me to take your coat?
N: (A) Thank you, that's kind of you.
N: (B) It's cold outside.
N: (C) I took the bus.

N: Number 57.
W: Have you seen the updated price list?
N: (A) I haven't checked my inbox yet.
N: (B) It costs twenty dollars.
N: (C) Yes, I'm updating it.

N: Number 58.
M: Should we order lunch for the whole team?
N: (A) Most of them are going to the client dinner.
N: (B) Whole wheat, please.
N: (C) The lunch was great.

N: Number 59.
W: Do you know when the new software will be ready?
N: (A) You should ask the IT manager.
N: (B) About ten o'clock.
N: (C) It's quite soft.

N: Number 60.
M: Is Ms. Taylor's presentation scheduled for this morning?
N: (A) The agenda is long.
N: (B) She presented well.
N: (C) The agenda was changed yesterday.

N: Number 61.
W: Would you rather meet on Tuesday or Wednesday?
N: (A) I met her on Monday.
N: (B) Whichever suits your schedule.
N: (C) Yes, on Wednesday.

N: Number 62.
M: Is it okay if I leave early today?
N: (A) Let me check with the manager.
N: (B) Yes, it's early.
N: (C) He left an hour ago.
